objective: Prove: every emergent knot of an NAE base is a signed NAE and every tie an equality or an inequality; a Pasch configuration forces NAE on its four complementary triples; a book of any number of pages is read faithfully; no base in which every pair lies in exactly lambda knots has a state beyond four distinctions.
status: Proved, refereed: under NAE with a state nothing is frozen, tied pairs are equal or unequal, hollow triples miss one complementary pair (L1, known); a Pasch has the octahedron's states (L2); a book of any size is read faithfully as the whole pattern (L3); the cut weighted by knots per pair is twice the knots exactly at states, designs with lambda >= 1 have no state beyond 4 (L4, known); same pair counts give the same states (L5). check.py C1 to C7 passed.
title: Four lemmas on what not-all-equal forces
